     5→# ESO syncs secrets from GCP SM to K8s via ExternalSecret + ClusterSecretStore.
     6→# ClusterSecretStore (gcp-secret-manager) is platform-managed - not in this code.
     7→# Uses the single-secret-per-call pattern for the secret-manager module.
     8→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
     9→
    10→# NOTE: Database uses IAM authentication via Cloud SQL Proxy - no password needed
    11→
    12→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    13→# Secret Manager: Rails Secrets
    14→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    15→# SECRET_KEY_BASE for Rails session encryption and signed cookies.
    16→# Replicates Helm chart behavior: 64-character alphanumeric string.
    17→# Terraform state preserves the value across applies (equivalent to Helm's
    18→# existing secret lookup pattern).
    19→#
    20→# ENCRYPTION_KEY for ActiveRecord encryption (hex format, 64 chars = 32 bytes).
    21→#
    22→# Active Record Encryption keys (64 chars each, matching Helm chart):
    23→# - ACTIVE_RECORD_ENCRYPTION_PRIMARY_KEY
    24→# - ACTIVE_RECORD_ENCRYPTION_DETERMINISTIC_KEY
    25→# - ACTIVE_RECORD_ENCRYPTION_KEY_DERIVATION_SALT
    26→
    27→resource "random_password" "rails_secret_key_base" {
    28→  length  = 64
    29→  special = false
    30→}
    31→
    32→resource "random_password" "active_record_encryption_primary_key" {
    33→  length  = 64
    34→  special = false
    35→}
    36→
    37→resource "random_password" "active_record_encryption_deterministic_key" {
    38→  length  = 64
    39→  special = false
    40→}
    41→
    42→resource "random_password" "active_record_encryption_key_derivation_salt" {
    43→  length  = 64
    44→  special = false
    45→}
    46→
    47→resource "random_id" "encryption_key" {
    48→  byte_length = 32
    49→}
    50→
    51→module "secret_rails_secrets" {
    52→  source = "github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules//terraform/gcp/secret-manager?ref=main"
    53→
    54→  project_id  = var.security_project_id
    55→  environment = var.environment
    56→  secret_id   = "crewai-rails-secrets-${var.environment}"
    57→  secret_data = jsonencode({
    58→    secret_key_base                              = random_password.rails_secret_key_base.result
    59→    encryption_key                               = random_id.encryption_key.hex
    60→    active_record_encryption_primary_key         = random_password.active_record_encryption_primary_key.result
    61→    active_record_encryption_deterministic_key   = random_password.active_record_encryption_deterministic_key.result
    62→    active_record_encryption_key_derivation_salt = random_password.active_record_encryption_key_derivation_salt.result
    63→  })
    64→
    65→  accessor_service_accounts = [local.crewai_sa_email]
    66→  additional_labels         = local.labels
    67→
    68→  depends_on = [google_service_account.crewai_platform]
    69→}
    70→
    71→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    72→# Secret Manager: GCS Credentials (HMAC Keys)
    73→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    74→# HMAC keys for S3-compatible GCS access (used by Rails ActiveStorage).
    75→
    76→module "secret_gcs_credentials" {
    77→  source = "github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules//terraform/gcp/secret-manager?ref=main"
    78→
    79→  project_id  = var.security_project_id
    80→  environment = var.environment
    81→  secret_id   = "crewai-gcs-credentials-${var.environment}"
    82→  secret_data = jsonencode({
    83→    access_key_id     = google_storage_hmac_key.crewai.access_id
    84→    secret_access_key = google_storage_hmac_key.crewai.secret
    85→  })
    86→
    87→  accessor_service_accounts = [local.crewai_sa_email]
    88→  additional_labels         = local.labels
    89→
    90→  depends_on = [google_service_account.crewai_platform]
    91→}
    92→
    93→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    94→# Secret Manager: WorkOS OAuth Credentials
    95→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    96→# WorkOS authentication credentials for SSO integration.
    97→# Note: These are development/staging credentials.
    98→
    99→module "secret_workos_credentials" {
   100→  source = "github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules//terraform/gcp/secret-manager?ref=main"
   101→
   102→  project_id  = var.security_project_id
   103→  environment = var.environment
   104→  secret_id   = "crewai-workos-credentials-${var.environment}"
   105→  secret_data = jsonencode({
   106→    client_id       = var.oauth_client_id
   107→    api_key         = var.oauth_api_key
   108→    cookie_password = var.oauth_cookie_password
   109→    authkit_domain  = var.oauth_domain
   110→  })
   111→
   112→  accessor_service_accounts = [local.crewai_sa_email]
   113→  additional_labels         = local.labels
   114→
   115→  depends_on = [google_service_account.crewai_platform]
   116→}
   117→
   118→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   119→# Secret Manager: GitHub App Credentials
   120→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   121→# GitHub App credentials for repository integration.
   122→# Note: These are development credentials for the crewai-git-dev GitHub App.
   123→
   124→module "secret_github_credentials" {
   125→  source = "github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules//terraform/gcp/secret-manager?ref=main"
   126→
   127→  project_id  = var.security_project_id
   128→  environment = var.environment
   129→  secret_id   = "crewai-github-credentials-${var.environment}"
   130→  secret_data = jsonencode({
   131→    client_secret   = var.github_client_secret
   132→    app_private_key = var.github_app_private_key
   133→  })
   134→
   135→  accessor_service_accounts = [local.crewai_sa_email]
   136→  additional_labels         = local.labels
   137→
   138→  depends_on = [google_service_account.crewai_platform]
   139→}
   140→
   141→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   142→# Secret Manager: Replicated SDK Credentials
   143→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   144→# Replicated SDK auth token for license validation and update checks.
   145→
   146→module "secret_replicated_credentials" {
   147→  source = "github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules//terraform/gcp/secret-manager?ref=main"
   148→
   149→  project_id  = var.security_project_id
   150→  environment = var.environment
   151→  secret_id   = "crewai-replicated-credentials-${var.environment}"
   152→  secret_data = jsonencode({
   153→    auth_token = var.replicated_auth_token
   154→  })
   155→
   156→  accessor_service_accounts = [local.crewai_sa_email]
   157→  additional_labels         = local.labels
   158→
   159→  depends_on = [google_service_account.crewai_platform]
   160→}
   161→
   162→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   163→# ExternalSecret: CrewAI Application Credentials
   164→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   165→# Uses ClusterSecretStore (platform-managed) to sync secrets from GCP SM.
   166→# ESO creates the K8s secret automatically - no direct secret creation needed.
   167→# The ClusterSecretStore 'gcp-secret-manager' is managed at platform level.
   168→#
   169→# Requires: External Secrets Operator CRD (external-secrets.io/v1beta1)
   170→# If ESO is not yet installed, set var.eso_installed = false to skip this
   171→# resource during initial cluster bootstrap, then re-apply after ESO is deployed.
   172→
   173→resource "kubernetes_manifest" "external_secret_crewai_credentials" {
   174→  count = var.eso_installed ? 1 : 0
   175→
   176→  manifest = {
   177→    apiVersion = "external-secrets.io/v1beta1"
   178→    kind       = "ExternalSecret"
   179→    metadata = {
   180→      name      = "crewai-credentials"
   181→      namespace = local.platform_namespace
   182→      labels = {
   183→        app         = "crewai"
   184→        environment = var.environment
   185→        managed-by  = "terraform"
   186→      }
   187→    }
   188→    spec = {
   189→      refreshInterval = "1h"
   190→      secretStoreRef = {
   191→        kind = "ClusterSecretStore"
   192→        name = "gcp-secret-manager"
   193→      }
   194→      target = {
   195→        name           = "crewai-secrets"
   196→        creationPolicy = "Owner"
   197→      }
   198→      data = [
   199→        {
   200→          secretKey = "SECRET_KEY_BASE"
   201→          remoteRef = {
   202→            key      = "crewai-rails-secrets-${var.environment}"
   203→            property = "secret_key_base"
   204→          }
   205→        },
   206→        {
   207→          secretKey = "ENCRYPTION_KEY"
   208→          remoteRef = {
   209→            key      = "crewai-rails-secrets-${var.environment}"
   210→            property = "encryption_key"
   211→          }
   212→        },
   213→        {
   214→          secretKey = "ACTIVE_RECORD_ENCRYPTION_PRIMARY_KEY"
   215→          remoteRef = {
   216→            key      = "crewai-rails-secrets-${var.environment}"
   217→            property = "active_record_encryption_primary_key"
   218→          }
   219→        },
   220→        {
   221→          secretKey = "ACTIVE_RECORD_ENCRYPTION_DETERMINISTIC_KEY"
   222→          remoteRef = {
   223→            key      = "crewai-rails-secrets-${var.environment}"
   224→            property = "active_record_encryption_deterministic_key"
   225→          }
   226→        },
   227→        {
   228→          secretKey = "ACTIVE_RECORD_ENCRYPTION_KEY_DERIVATION_SALT"
   229→          remoteRef = {
   230→            key      = "crewai-rails-secrets-${var.environment}"
   231→            property = "active_record_encryption_key_derivation_salt"
   232→          }
   233→        },
   234→        {
   235→          secretKey = "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"
   236→          remoteRef = {
   237→            key      = "crewai-gcs-credentials-${var.environment}"
   238→            property = "access_key_id"
   239→          }
   240→        },
   241→        {
   242→          secretKey = "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
   243→          remoteRef = {
   244→            key      = "crewai-gcs-credentials-${var.environment}"
   245→            property = "secret_access_key"
   246→          }
   247→        },
   248→        {
   249→          secretKey = "WORKOS_CLIENT_ID"
   250→          remoteRef = {
   251→            key      = "crewai-workos-credentials-${var.environment}"
   252→            property = "client_id"
   253→          }
   254→        },
   255→        {
   256→          secretKey = "WORKOS_API_KEY"
   257→          remoteRef = {
   258→            key      = "crewai-workos-credentials-${var.environment}"
   259→            property = "api_key"
   260→          }
   261→        },
   262→        {
   263→          secretKey = "WORKOS_COOKIE_PASSWORD"
   264→          remoteRef = {
   265→            key      = "crewai-workos-credentials-${var.environment}"
   266→            property = "cookie_password"
   267→          }
   268→        },
   269→        {
   270→          secretKey = "WORKOS_AUTHKIT_DOMAIN"
   271→          remoteRef = {
   272→            key      = "crewai-workos-credentials-${var.environment}"
   273→            property = "authkit_domain"
   274→          }
   275→        },
   276→        {
   277→          secretKey = "GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET"
   278→          remoteRef = {
   279→            key      = "crewai-github-credentials-${var.environment}"
   280→            property = "client_secret"
   281→          }
   282→        },
   283→        {
   284→          secretKey = "GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY"
   285→          remoteRef = {
   286→            key      = "crewai-github-credentials-${var.environment}"
   287→            property = "app_private_key"
   288→          }
   289→        },
   290→        {
   291→          secretKey = "REPLICATED_AUTH_TOKEN"
   292→          remoteRef = {
   293→            key      = "crewai-replicated-credentials-${var.environment}"
   294→            property = "auth_token"
   295→          }
   296→        }
   297→      ]
   298→    }
   299→  }
   300→
   301→  depends_on = [
   302→    kubernetes_namespace.crewai_platform,
   303→    module.secret_rails_secrets,
   304→    module.secret_gcs_credentials,
   305→    module.secret_workos_credentials,
   306→    module.secret_github_credentials,
   307→    module.secret_replicated_credentials
   308→  ]
   309→}
   310→

     1→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
     2→# CrewAI Platform - Dev Environment
     3→#
     4→# Terraform configuration for CrewAI Enterprise deployment on GKE.
     5→# Composes remote modules from kix-platform-modules plus inline resources.
     6→#
     7→# File Organization:
     8→# - main.tf           : Providers, data sources, locals (this file)
     9→# - service-accounts.tf: GCP service account and IAM bindings
    10→# - kubernetes.tf     : Namespaces, K8s service accounts, quotas, limits
    11→# - secrets.tf        : Secret Manager and K8s secrets/configmaps
    12→# - storage.tf        : GCS buckets and HMAC keys
    13→# - database.tf       : Cloud SQL databases, user, and proxy deployment
    14→# - artifact-registry.tf: Container registry for crew builds
    15→# - variables.tf      : Input variable definitions
    16→# - outputs.tf        : Output value definitions
    17→# - versions.tf       : Provider version constraints
    18→# - backend.tf        : Remote state configuration
    19→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    20→
    21→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    22→# Locals
    23→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    24→# Common values used across multiple resources.
    25→
    26→locals {
    27→  # Standard labels applied to all resources for identification and cost tracking
    28→  labels = {
    29→    app         = "crewai"
    30→    environment = var.environment
    31→    managed-by  = "terraform"
    32→    platform    = "crewai"
    33→  }
    34→
    35→  # Construct SA email statically to avoid for_each unknown value issues.
    36→  # Secret-manager modules use depends_on to ensure the SA exists before
    37→  # IAM bindings are created (static email breaks implicit dependency).
    38→  crewai_sa_email = "crewai-platform@${var.gke_project_id}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
    39→}
    40→
    41→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    42→# Providers
    43→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    44→
    45→provider "google" {
    46→  project = var.gke_project_id
    47→  region  = var.region
    48→}
    49→
    50→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    51→# Data Sources: GKE Cluster for Kubernetes Provider
    52→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    53→# Explicit GKE authentication for reproducible deployments.
    54→# Avoids reliance on KUBECONFIG environment variable.
    55→
    56→data "google_client_config" "default" {}
    57→
    58→data "google_container_cluster" "gke" {
    59→  project  = var.gke_project_id
    60→  name     = var.gke_cluster_name
    61→  location = var.region
    62→}
    63→
    64→provider "kubernetes" {
    65→  host                   = "https://${data.google_container_cluster.gke.endpoint}"
    66→  token                  = data.google_client_config.default.access_token
    67→  cluster_ca_certificate = base64decode(data.google_container_cluster.gke.master_auth[0].cluster_ca_certificate)
    68→}
    69→

     1→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
     2→# Service Accounts and IAM Bindings
     3→#
     4→# GCP service account for CrewAI platform workloads with Workload Identity.
     5→# Includes all IAM bindings for Cloud SQL, GCS, and Artifact Registry access.
     6→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
     7→
     8→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
     9→# GCP Service Account
    10→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    11→# Created inline (not via module) to avoid circular dependencies with HMAC keys
    12→# and secrets that reference the service account email.
    13→
    14→resource "google_service_account" "crewai_platform" {
    15→  project      = var.gke_project_id
    16→  account_id   = "crewai-platform"
    17→  display_name = "CrewAI Platform"
    18→}
    19→
    20→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    21→# IAM: Cloud SQL Access
    22→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    23→# Allows the service account to connect to Cloud SQL via the Cloud SQL Proxy.
    24→
    25→resource "google_project_iam_member" "cloudsql_client" {
    26→  project = var.platform_data_project
    27→  role    = "roles/cloudsql.client"
    28→  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.crewai_platform.email}"
    29→}
    30→
    31→resource "google_project_iam_member" "cloudsql_instance_user" {
    32→  project = var.platform_data_project
    33→  role    = "roles/cloudsql.instanceUser"
    34→  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.crewai_platform.email}"
    35→}
    36→
    37→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    38→# IAM: GCS Bucket Access
    39→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    40→# Data bucket: full object admin for reading and writing application data.
    41→# Logs bucket: object creator only for write-only audit logging.
    42→
    43→resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "data_bucket" {
    44→  bucket = module.gcs_data.bucket_name
    45→  role   = "roles/storage.objectAdmin"
    46→  member = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.crewai_platform.email}"
    47→}
    48→
    49→resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "logs_bucket" {
    50→  bucket = module.gcs_logs.bucket_name
    51→  role   = "roles/storage.objectCreator"
    52→  member = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.crewai_platform.email}"
    53→}
    54→
    55→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    56→# IAM: Shared Artifact Registry Access
    57→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    58→# Allows the service account to pull container images from the shared
    59→# Artifact Registry repository (crewai-images in kd-ix-eur-shr-artifacts).
    60→# These are the mirrored CrewAI platform images synced from images.crewai.com.
    61→
    62→resource "google_artifact_registry_repository_iam_member" "shared_ar_reader" {
    63→  project    = var.shared_artifacts_project
    64→  location   = var.region
    65→  repository = var.shared_ar_repository
    66→  role       = "roles/artifactregistry.reader"
    67→  member     = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.crewai_platform.email}"
    68→}
    69→
    70→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    71→# IAM: Secret Manager Access (for External Secrets Operator)
    72→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    73→# Allows the service account to access secrets in Secret Manager.
    74→# Required for ESO to pull secrets and create Kubernetes secrets.
    75→
    76→resource "google_project_iam_member" "secret_accessor" {
    77→  project = var.security_project_id
    78→  role    = "roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor"
    79→  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.crewai_platform.email}"
    80→}
    81→
    82→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    83→# IAM: Workload Identity Binding
    84→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    85→# Allows the Kubernetes service account to impersonate the GCP service account.
    86→# This enables pods to authenticate to GCP services without service account keys.
    87→
    88→resource "google_service_account_iam_member" "workload_identity" {
    89→  service_account_id = google_service_account.crewai_platform.name
    90→  role               = "roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser"
    91→  member             = "serviceAccount:${var.gke_project_id}.svc.id.goog[crewai/crewai-sa]"
    92→}
    93→
    94→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    95→# IAM: GitHub Actions Impersonation
    96→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    97→# Allows GitHub Actions to impersonate this service account for CI/CD.
    98→# The GitHub service account is created separately in the platform infrastructure.
    99→
   100→resource "google_service_account_iam_member" "github_impersonation" {
   101→  service_account_id = google_service_account.crewai_platform.name
   102→  role               = "roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator"
   103→  member             = "serviceAccount:github-crewai-${var.environment}@${var.gke_project_id}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
   104→}
   105→

## Summary

I've successfully inlined all remote Terraform modules in the dev environment at `/home/nathan_booth/code/konecta/konecta-tic/kix-services-crewai/environments/dev/terraform/`. Here's what was done:

- `module "gcs_data"` → `resource "google_storage_bucket" "gcs_data"`
- `module "gcs_logs"` → `resource "google_storage_bucket" "gcs_logs"`

Each bucket includes:
- Name: `crewai-{data|logs}-${var.environment}`
- Storage class: `STANDARD`
- Versioning: enabled
- Uniform bucket-level access: enabled
- Public access prevention: enforced
- Force destroy: `true` (dev only)
- Labels: `environment`, `use_case`, `managed_by`, `cost_center`, `project`, `compliance`

#### 2. **secrets.tf**
Replaced 5 Secret Manager module calls with inline resources (3 resources per secret):
- `module "secret_rails_secrets"` → `google_secret_manager_secret.rails_secrets`, `google_secret_manager_secret_version.rails_secrets`, `google_secret_manager_secret_iam_member.rails_secrets`
- `module "secret_gcs_credentials"` → Similar pattern
- `module "secret_workos_credentials"` → Similar pattern
- `module "secret_github_credentials"` → Similar pattern
- `module "secret_replicated_credentials"` → Similar pattern

Each secret includes:
- Replication to `europe-west1` and `europe-west4`
- Labels merged from `local.labels` plus `environment` and `managed_by`
- IAM member granting `roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor` to `crewai-platform` SA

Updated ExternalSecret `depends_on` to reference the secret version resources instead of modules.

#### 3. **outputs.tf**
Updated bucket name outputs:
- `module.gcs_data.bucket_name` → `google_storage_bucket.gcs_data.name`
- `module.gcs_logs.bucket_name` → `google_storage_bucket.gcs_logs.name`

#### 4. **service-accounts.tf**

- `module.gcs_data.bucket_name` → `google_storage_bucket.gcs_data.name`
- `module.gcs_logs.bucket_name` → `google_storage_bucket.gcs_logs.name`

#### 5. **moved.tf** (NEW)
Created comprehensive state migration blocks covering:
- 2 GCS bucket moves
- 15 Secret Manager resource moves (3 per secret: secret, version, IAM member)

All moved blocks use the correct service account email in the IAM member for_each key: `crewai-platform@kd-ix-eur-dev-gke.iam.gserviceaccount.com`

    75→  provider = google
    76→  project  = var.platform_data_project
    77→  instance = data.google_sql_database_instance.platform.name
    78→  name     = "crewai"
    79→  password = random_password.db_password.result
    80→}
    81→
    82→module "gcs_data" {
    83→  source = "github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules//terraform/gcp/data-services/gcs?ref=main"
    84→
    85→  project_id  = var.gke_project_id
    86→  environment = var.environment
    87→  use_case    = "crewai"
    88→  name_suffix = "data"
    89→  cost_center = "platform"
    90→  location    = var.region
    91→}
    92→
    93→module "gcs_logs" {
    94→  source = "github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules//terraform/gcp/data-services/gcs?ref=main"
    95→
    96→  project_id  = var.gke_project_id
    97→  environment = var.environment
    98→  use_case    = "crewai"
    99→  name_suffix = "logs"
   100→  cost_center = "platform"
   101→  location    = var.region
   102→}
   103→
   104→resource "google_service_account" "crewai_platform" {
   105→  project      = var.gke_project_id
   106→  account_id   = "crewai-platform-${var.environment}"
   107→  display_name = "CrewAI Platform - ${var.environment}"
   108→}
   109→
   110→resource "google_storage_hmac_key" "crewai" {
   111→  project               = var.gke_project_id
   112→  service_account_email = google_service_account.crewai_platform.email
   113→}
   114→
   115→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   116→# Secret Manager: Database Credentials
   117→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   118→# Password-based Cloud SQL authentication (QA uses password, not IAM auth).
   119→
   120→module "secret_db_credentials" {
   121→  source = "github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules//terraform/gcp/secret-manager?ref=main"
   122→
   123→  project_id  = var.security_project_id
   124→  environment = var.environment
   125→  secret_id   = "crewai-db-credentials-${var.environment}"
   126→  secret_data = jsonencode({
   127→    password = random_password.db_password.result
   128→    host     = data.google_sql_database_instance.platform.private_ip_address
   129→    port     = 5432
   130→    database = "crewai_plus_production"
   131→    username = "crewai"
   132→  })
   133→
   134→  accessor_service_accounts = [local.crewai_sa_email]
   135→  additional_labels         = local.labels
   136→
   137→  depends_on = [google_service_account.crewai_platform]
   138→}
   139→
   140→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   141→# Secret Manager: Rails Secrets
   142→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   143→# SECRET_KEY_BASE for Rails session encryption and PLATFORM_MASTER_KEY.
   144→
   145→module "secret_rails_secrets" {
   146→  source = "github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules//terraform/gcp/secret-manager?ref=main"
   147→
   148→  project_id  = var.security_project_id
   149→  environment = var.environment
   150→  secret_id   = "crewai-rails-secrets-${var.environment}"
   151→  secret_data = jsonencode({
   152→    secret_key_base     = random_password.secret_key_base.result
   153→    platform_master_key = random_password.platform_master_key.result
   154→  })
   155→
   156→  accessor_service_accounts = [local.crewai_sa_email]
   157→  additional_labels         = local.labels
   158→
   159→  depends_on = [google_service_account.crewai_platform]
   160→}
   161→
   162→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   163→# Secret Manager: GCS Credentials (HMAC Keys)
   164→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   165→# HMAC keys for S3-compatible GCS access (used by Rails ActiveStorage).
   166→
   167→module "secret_gcs_credentials" {
   168→  source = "github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules//terraform/gcp/secret-manager?ref=main"
   169→
   170→  project_id  = var.security_project_id
   171→  environment = var.environment
   172→  secret_id   = "crewai-gcs-credentials-${var.environment}"
   173→  secret_data = jsonencode({
   174→    access_key_id     = google_storage_hmac_key.crewai.access_id
   175→    secret_access_key = google_storage_hmac_key.crewai.secret
   176→  })
   177→
   178→  accessor_service_accounts = [local.crewai_sa_email]
   179→  additional_labels         = local.labels
   180→
   181→  depends_on = [google_service_account.crewai_platform]
   182→}
   183→
   184→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   185→# Secret Manager: WorkOS OAuth Credentials
   186→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   187→# WorkOS authentication credentials for SSO integration.
   188→
   189→module "secret_workos_credentials" {
   190→  source = "github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules//terraform/gcp/secret-manager?ref=main"
   191→
   192→  project_id  = var.security_project_id
   193→  environment = var.environment
   194→  secret_id   = "crewai-workos-credentials-${var.environment}"
   195→  secret_data = jsonencode({
   196→    client_id       = var.oauth_client_id
   197→    api_key         = var.oauth_api_key
   198→    cookie_password = random_password.workos_cookie_password.result
   199→    authkit_domain  = var.oauth_domain
   200→  })
   201→
   202→  accessor_service_accounts = [local.crewai_sa_email]
   203→  additional_labels         = local.labels
   204→
   205→  depends_on = [google_service_account.crewai_platform]
   206→}
   207→
   208→resource "google_project_iam_member" "cloudsql_client" {
   209→  project = var.platform_data_project
   210→  role    = "roles/cloudsql.client"
   211→  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.crewai_platform.email}"
   212→}
   213→
   214→resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "data_bucket" {
   215→  bucket = module.gcs_data.bucket_name
   216→  role   = "roles/storage.objectAdmin"
   217→  member = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.crewai_platform.email}"
   218→}

   220→resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "logs_bucket" {

   226→resource "google_service_account_iam_member" "workload_identity" {

   230→}

   232→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

   234→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   235→
   236→resource "google_artifact_registry_repository" "crewai_builder" {
   237→  project       = var.gke_project_id
   238→  location      = var.region
   239→  repository_id = "crewai-${var.environment}"

   243→  labels = local.labels

   245→
   246→resource "google_artifact_registry_repository_iam_member" "builder_writer" {
   247→  project    = var.gke_project_id

   250→  role       = "roles/artifactregistry.writer"

   252→}
   253→
   254→module "gke_config" {
   255→  source = "github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules//terraform/kubernetes/gke-config?ref=main"
   256→
   257→  environment = var.environment
   258→  project_id  = var.gke_project_id
   259→
   260→  namespaces = {
   261→    "crewai-${var.environment}" = {
   262→      display_name = "CrewAI Platform"
   263→      labels       = {}
   264→      annotations  = {}
   265→      service_account = {
   266→        create              = true
   267→        name                = "crewai-platform-sa"
   268→        gcp_service_account = google_service_account.crewai_platform.email
   269→        automount_token     = false
   270→      }
   271→      resource_quota = {
   272→        requests_cpu    = "30"
   273→        requests_memory = "60Gi"
   274→        limits_cpu      = "60"
   275→        limits_memory   = "120Gi"
   276→        pods            = "80"
   277→        services        = "20"
   278→        secrets         = "30"
   279→        configmaps      = "30"
   280→        pvcs            = "10"
   281→      }
   282→      limit_range = null
   283→      network_isolation = {
   284→        enabled                   = true
   285→        allow_from_namespaces     = []
   286→        allow_from_system         = true
   287→        allow_egress_internet     = true
   288→        allow_egress_dns          = true
   289→        custom_ingress_rules      = []
   290→        custom_egress_rules       = []
   291→        enable_component_egress   = false
   292→        deny_egress_components    = []
   293→        component_egress_policies = []
   294→      }
   295→      rbac = null
   296→    }
   297→    "crewai-crews-${var.environment}" = {
   298→      display_name = "CrewAI Crew Workloads"
   299→      labels       = {}
   300→      annotations  = {}
   301→      service_account = {
   302→        create          = true
   303→        name            = "crewai-crews-sa"
   304→        automount_token = false
   305→      }
   306→      resource_quota = {
   307→        requests_cpu    = "60"
   308→        requests_memory = "120Gi"
   309→        limits_cpu      = "120"
   310→        limits_memory   = "240Gi"
   311→        pods            = "200"
   312→        services        = "10"
   313→        secrets         = "20"
   314→        configmaps      = "20"
   315→        pvcs            = "10"
   316→      }
   317→      limit_range = null
   318→      network_isolation = {
   319→        enabled                   = true
   320→        allow_from_namespaces     = ["crewai-${var.environment}"]
   321→        allow_from_system         = true
   322→        allow_egress_internet     = true
   323→        allow_egress_dns          = true
   324→        custom_ingress_rules      = []
   325→        custom_egress_rules       = []
   326→        enable_component_egress   = false
   327→        deny_egress_components    = []
   328→        component_egress_policies = []
   329→      }
   330→      rbac = null
   331→    }
   332→  }
   333→}
   334→
   335→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   336→# ExternalSecret: CrewAI Application Credentials
   337→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   338→# Uses ClusterSecretStore (platform-managed) to sync secrets from GCP SM.
   339→# ESO creates the K8s secret automatically - no direct secret creation needed.
   340→# The ClusterSecretStore 'gcp-secret-manager' is managed at platform level.
   341→
   342→resource "kubernetes_manifest" "external_secret_crewai_credentials" {
   343→  manifest = {
   344→    apiVersion = "external-secrets.io/v1beta1"
   345→    kind       = "ExternalSecret"
   346→    metadata = {
   347→      name      = "crewai-credentials"
   348→      namespace = local.platform_namespace
   349→      labels = {
   350→        app         = "crewai"
   351→        environment = var.environment
   352→        managed-by  = "terraform"
   353→      }
   354→    }
   355→    spec = {
   356→      refreshInterval = "1h"
   357→      secretStoreRef = {
   358→        kind = "ClusterSecretStore"
   359→        name = "gcp-secret-manager"
   360→      }
   361→      target = {
   362→        name           = "crewai-secrets"
   363→        creationPolicy = "Owner"
   364→      }
   365→      data = [
   366→        {
   367→          secretKey = "DB_PASSWORD"
   368→          remoteRef = {
   369→            key      = "crewai-db-credentials-${var.environment}"
   370→            property = "password"
   371→          }
   372→        },
   373→        {
   374→          secretKey = "SECRET_KEY_BASE"
   375→          remoteRef = {
   376→            key      = "crewai-rails-secrets-${var.environment}"
   377→            property = "secret_key_base"
   378→          }
   379→        },
   380→        {
   381→          secretKey = "PLATFORM_MASTER_KEY"
   382→          remoteRef = {
   383→            key      = "crewai-rails-secrets-${var.environment}"
   384→            property = "platform_master_key"
   385→          }
   386→        },
   387→        {
   388→          secretKey = "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"
   389→          remoteRef = {
   390→            key      = "crewai-gcs-credentials-${var.environment}"
   391→            property = "access_key_id"
   392→          }
   393→        },
   394→        {
   395→          secretKey = "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
   396→          remoteRef = {
   397→            key      = "crewai-gcs-credentials-${var.environment}"
   398→            property = "secret_access_key"
   399→          }
   400→        },
   401→        {
   402→          secretKey = "WORKOS_CLIENT_ID"
   403→          remoteRef = {
   404→            key      = "crewai-workos-credentials-${var.environment}"
   405→            property = "client_id"
   406→          }
   407→        },
   408→        {
   409→          secretKey = "WORKOS_API_KEY"
   410→          remoteRef = {
   411→            key      = "crewai-workos-credentials-${var.environment}"
   412→            property = "api_key"
   413→          }
   414→        },
   415→        {
   416→          secretKey = "WORKOS_COOKIE_PASSWORD"
   417→          remoteRef = {
   418→            key      = "crewai-workos-credentials-${var.environment}"
   419→            property = "cookie_password"
   420→          }
   421→        },
   422→        {
   423→          secretKey = "WORKOS_AUTHKIT_DOMAIN"
   424→          remoteRef = {
   425→            key      = "crewai-workos-credentials-${var.environment}"
   426→            property = "authkit_domain"
   427→          }
   428→        }
   429→      ]
   430→    }
   431→  }
   432→
   433→  depends_on = [
   434→    module.gke_config,
   435→    module.secret_db_credentials,
   436→    module.secret_rails_secrets,
   437→    module.secret_gcs_credentials,
   438→    module.secret_workos_credentials
   439→  ]
   440→}
   441→

     1→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
     2→# Secrets Management
     3→#
     4→# GCP Secret Manager secrets consumed by External Secrets Operator (ESO).
     5→# ESO syncs secrets from GCP SM to K8s via ExternalSecret + ClusterSecretStore.
     6→# ClusterSecretStore (gcp-secret-manager) is platform-managed - not in this code.
     7→# Uses the single-secret-per-call pattern for the secret-manager module.
     8→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
     9→
    10→# NOTE: Prod uses password-based Cloud SQL authentication (no IAM auth)
    11→
    12→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    13→# Secret Manager: Rails Secrets
    14→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    15→# SECRET_KEY_BASE for Rails session encryption and signed cookies.
    16→# PLATFORM_MASTER_KEY for Rails credentials encryption.
    17→
    18→resource "random_password" "rails_secret_key_base" {
    19→  length  = 128
    20→  special = false
    21→}
    22→
    23→resource "random_password" "platform_master_key" {
    24→  length  = 32
    25→  special = false
    26→}
    27→
    28→module "secret_rails_secrets" {
    29→  source = "github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules//terraform/gcp/secret-manager?ref=main"
    30→
    31→  project_id  = var.security_project_id
    32→  environment = var.environment
    33→  secret_id   = "crewai-rails-secrets-${var.environment}"
    34→  secret_data = jsonencode({
    35→    secret_key_base     = random_password.rails_secret_key_base.result
    36→    platform_master_key = random_password.platform_master_key.result
    37→  })
    38→
    39→  accessor_service_accounts = [google_service_account.crewai_platform.email]
    40→  additional_labels         = local.labels
    41→}
    42→
    43→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    44→# Secret Manager: Database Credentials
    45→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    46→# Prod uses password-based authentication for Cloud SQL.
    47→
    48→module "secret_db_credentials" {
    49→  source = "github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules//terraform/gcp/secret-manager?ref=main"
    50→
    51→  project_id  = var.security_project_id
    52→  environment = var.environment
    53→  secret_id   = "crewai-db-credentials-${var.environment}"
    54→  secret_data = jsonencode({
    55→    password = random_password.db_password.result
    56→    host     = data.google_sql_database_instance.platform.private_ip_address
    57→    port     = 5432
    58→    database = "crewai_plus_production"
    59→    username = "crewai"
    60→  })
    61→
    62→  accessor_service_accounts = [google_service_account.crewai_platform.email]
    63→  additional_labels         = local.labels
    64→}
    65→
    66→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    67→# Secret Manager: GCS Credentials (HMAC Keys)
    68→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    69→# HMAC keys for S3-compatible GCS access (used by Rails ActiveStorage).
    70→
    71→module "secret_gcs_credentials" {
    72→  source = "github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules//terraform/gcp/secret-manager?ref=main"
    73→
    74→  project_id  = var.security_project_id
    75→  environment = var.environment
    76→  secret_id   = "crewai-gcs-credentials-${var.environment}"
    77→  secret_data = jsonencode({
    78→    access_key_id     = google_storage_hmac_key.crewai.access_id
    79→    secret_access_key = google_storage_hmac_key.crewai.secret
    80→  })
    81→
    82→  accessor_service_accounts = [google_service_account.crewai_platform.email]
    83→  additional_labels         = local.labels
    84→}
    85→
    86→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    87→# Secret Manager: WorkOS OAuth Credentials
    88→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    89→# WorkOS authentication credentials for SSO integration.
    90→# Note: Production credentials should be updated via variable overrides.
    91→
    92→module "secret_workos_credentials" {
    93→  source = "github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules//terraform/gcp/secret-manager?ref=main"
    94→
    95→  project_id  = var.security_project_id
    96→  environment = var.environment
    97→  secret_id   = "crewai-workos-credentials-${var.environment}"
    98→  secret_data = jsonencode({
    99→    client_id       = var.oauth_client_id
   100→    api_key         = var.oauth_api_key
   101→    cookie_password = random_password.workos_cookie_password.result
   102→    authkit_domain  = var.oauth_domain
   103→  })
   104→
   105→  accessor_service_accounts = [google_service_account.crewai_platform.email]
   106→  additional_labels         = local.labels
   107→}
   108→
   109→# WorkOS cookie password - generated securely
   110→resource "random_password" "workos_cookie_password" {
   111→  length  = 32
   112→  special = false
   113→}
   114→
   115→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   116→# ExternalSecret: CrewAI Application Credentials
   117→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   118→# Uses ClusterSecretStore (platform-managed) to sync secrets from GCP SM.
   119→# ESO creates the K8s secret automatically - no direct secret creation needed.
   120→# The ClusterSecretStore 'gcp-secret-manager' is managed at platform level.
   121→
   122→resource "kubernetes_manifest" "external_secret_crewai_credentials" {
   123→  manifest = {
   124→    apiVersion = "external-secrets.io/v1beta1"
   125→    kind       = "ExternalSecret"
   126→    metadata = {
   127→      name      = "crewai-credentials"
   128→      namespace = "crewai-${var.environment}"
   129→      labels = {
   130→        app         = "crewai"
   131→        environment = var.environment
   132→        managed-by  = "terraform"
   133→      }
   134→    }
   135→    spec = {
   136→      refreshInterval = "1h"
   137→      secretStoreRef = {
   138→        kind = "ClusterSecretStore"
   139→        name = "gcp-secret-manager"
   140→      }
   141→      target = {
   142→        name           = "crewai-secrets"
   143→        creationPolicy = "Owner"
   144→      }
   145→      data = [
   146→        {
   147→          secretKey = "DB_PASSWORD"
   148→          remoteRef = {
   149→            key      = "crewai-db-credentials-${var.environment}"
   150→            property = "password"
   151→          }
   152→        },
   153→        {
   154→          secretKey = "SECRET_KEY_BASE"
   155→          remoteRef = {
   156→            key      = "crewai-rails-secrets-${var.environment}"
   157→            property = "secret_key_base"
   158→          }
   159→        },
   160→        {
   161→          secretKey = "PLATFORM_MASTER_KEY"
   162→          remoteRef = {
   163→            key      = "crewai-rails-secrets-${var.environment}"
   164→            property = "platform_master_key"
   165→          }
   166→        },
   167→        {
   168→          secretKey = "AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"
   169→          remoteRef = {
   170→            key      = "crewai-gcs-credentials-${var.environment}"
   171→            property = "access_key_id"
   172→          }
   173→        },
   174→        {
   175→          secretKey = "AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY"
   176→          remoteRef = {
   177→            key      = "crewai-gcs-credentials-${var.environment}"
   178→            property = "secret_access_key"
   179→          }
   180→        },
   181→        {
   182→          secretKey = "WORKOS_CLIENT_ID"
   183→          remoteRef = {
   184→            key      = "crewai-workos-credentials-${var.environment}"
   185→            property = "client_id"
   186→          }
   187→        },
   188→        {
   189→          secretKey = "WORKOS_API_KEY"
   190→          remoteRef = {
   191→            key      = "crewai-workos-credentials-${var.environment}"
   192→            property = "api_key"
   193→          }
   194→        },
   195→        {
   196→          secretKey = "WORKOS_COOKIE_PASSWORD"
   197→          remoteRef = {
   198→            key      = "crewai-workos-credentials-${var.environment}"
   199→            property = "cookie_password"
   200→          }
   201→        },
   202→        {
   203→          secretKey = "WORKOS_AUTHKIT_DOMAIN"
   204→          remoteRef = {
   205→            key      = "crewai-workos-credentials-${var.environment}"
   206→            property = "authkit_domain"
   207→          }
   208→        }
   209→      ]
   210→    }
   211→  }
   212→
   213→  depends_on = [
   214→    module.gke_config,
   215→    module.secret_rails_secrets,
   216→    module.secret_db_credentials,
   217→    module.secret_gcs_credentials,
   218→    module.secret_workos_credentials
   219→  ]
   220→}
   221→

     1→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
     2→# Kubernetes Resources
     3→#
     4→# Namespaces, service accounts, limit ranges, and resource quotas for CrewAI.
     5→# Terraform creates the namespaces so K8s resources can be provisioned.
     6→# ArgoCD will adopt the namespace via CreateNamespace=true (no-op if exists).
     7→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
     8→
     9→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    10→# Local Variables for Namespace Names
    11→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    12→
    13→locals {
    14→  platform_namespace = "crewai"
    15→  crews_namespace    = "crewai-crews"
    16→}
    17→
    18→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    19→# Namespaces
    20→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    21→# Created by Terraform to ensure K8s resources can be provisioned.
    22→# ArgoCD will adopt these namespaces (CreateNamespace is a no-op if exists).
    23→
    24→resource "kubernetes_namespace" "crewai_platform" {
    25→  metadata {
    26→    name = local.platform_namespace
    27→    labels = merge(local.labels, {
    28→      "app.kubernetes.io/managed-by" = "terraform"
    29→    })
    30→  }
    31→
    32→  lifecycle {
    33→    ignore_changes = [
    34→      metadata[0].labels,
    35→      metadata[0].annotations,
    36→    ]
    37→  }
    38→}
    39→
    40→resource "kubernetes_namespace" "crewai_crews" {
    41→  metadata {
    42→    name = local.crews_namespace
    43→    labels = merge(local.labels, {
    44→      "app.kubernetes.io/managed-by" = "terraform"
    45→    })
    46→  }
    47→
    48→  lifecycle {
    49→    ignore_changes = [
    50→      metadata[0].labels,
    51→      metadata[0].annotations,
    52→    ]
    53→  }
    54→}
    55→
    56→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    57→# Kubernetes Service Accounts
    58→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    59→# Platform SA is created by Helm (PreSync wave -35) to ensure it exists
    60→# before cloud-sql-proxy deployment. Terraform manages the GCP SA and IAM
    61→# bindings; the Workload Identity binding references the K8s SA by name.
    62→#
    63→# Crews SA is created here - crew pods don't need Helm sync wave ordering.
    64→# Token automount is disabled for security; pods explicitly mount if needed.
    65→
    66→resource "kubernetes_service_account" "crewai_crews" {
    67→  metadata {
    68→    name      = "crewai-crews-sa"
    69→    namespace = local.crews_namespace
    70→    labels    = local.labels
    71→  }
    72→  automount_service_account_token = false
    73→
    74→  depends_on = [kubernetes_namespace.crewai_crews]
    75→}
    76→
    77→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    78→# Limit Ranges
    79→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    80→# Default resource limits for containers without explicit limits set.
    81→# Platform namespace has lower defaults; crews namespace allows more resources.
    82→
    83→resource "kubernetes_limit_range" "crewai_platform" {
    84→  metadata {
    85→    name      = "crewai-platform-limits"
    86→    namespace = local.platform_namespace
    87→    labels    = local.labels
    88→  }
    89→  spec {
    90→    limit {
    91→      type = "Container"
    92→      # Right-sized: platform workloads are I/O-bound, not compute-bound.
    93→      # Defaults apply to containers without explicit resource specs.
    94→      default = {
    95→        cpu    = "250m"
    96→        memory = "256Mi"
    97→      }
    98→      default_request = {
    99→        cpu    = "50m"
   100→        memory = "64Mi"
   101→      }
   102→    }
   103→  }
   104→
   105→  depends_on = [kubernetes_namespace.crewai_platform]
   106→}
   107→
   108→resource "kubernetes_limit_range" "crewai_crews" {
   109→  metadata {
   110→    name      = "crewai-crews-limits"
   111→    namespace = local.crews_namespace
   112→    labels    = local.labels
   113→  }
   114→  spec {
   115→    limit {
   116→      type = "Container"
   117→      # Right-sized for I/O-bound crew workloads (LLM API orchestrators).
   118→      # Worker pods need burst capacity; web/redis pods are lightweight.
   119→      default = {
   120→        cpu    = "500m"
   121→        memory = "512Mi"
   122→      }
   123→      default_request = {
   124→        cpu    = "100m"
   125→        memory = "128Mi"
   126→      }
   127→    }
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  depends_on = [kubernetes_namespace.crewai_crews]
   131→}
   132→
   133→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   134→# Resource Quotas
   135→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   136→# Hard limits on total resources consumed per namespace.
   137→# Platform namespace is smaller; crews namespace allows burst capacity.
   138→
   139→resource "kubernetes_resource_quota" "crewai_platform" {
   140→  metadata {
   141→    name      = "crewai-platform-quota"
   142→    namespace = local.platform_namespace
   143→    labels    = local.labels
   144→  }
   145→  spec {
   146→    hard = {
   147→      # Right-sized: platform services total ~600m/1.3Gi requests at baseline,
   148→      # ~3Gi with autoscaling headroom. Limits set at ~2x requests quota.
   149→      "requests.cpu"         = "4"
   150→      "requests.memory"      = "8Gi"
   151→      "limits.cpu"           = "8"
   152→      "limits.memory"        = "16Gi"
   153→      pods                   = "30"
   154→      services               = "20"
   155→      secrets                = "30"
   156→      configmaps             = "30"
   157→      persistentvolumeclaims = "10"
   158→    }
   159→  }
   160→  depends_on = [kubernetes_limit_range.crewai_platform]
   161→}
   162→
   163→resource "kubernetes_resource_quota" "crewai_crews" {
   164→  metadata {
   165→    name      = "crewai-crews-quota"
   166→    namespace = local.crews_namespace
   167→    labels    = local.labels
   168→  }
   169→  spec {
   170→    hard = {
   171→      # Right-sized: ~20 crews × 3 pods × ~100m avg request = ~6 CPU, ~15Gi mem.
   172→      # Headroom for growth to ~30 crews with right-sized requests.
   173→      "requests.cpu"         = "12"
   174→      "requests.memory"      = "24Gi"
   175→      "limits.cpu"           = "24"
   176→      "limits.memory"        = "48Gi"

   179→      secrets                = "20"

   181→      persistentvolumeclaims = "10"
   182→    }
   183→  }
   184→  depends_on = [kubernetes_limit_range.crewai_crews]

> AGENT

All module inlining is complete and verified. Here's the summary:

### What was done

Removed all 18+ remote module dependencies on `github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules` across all three environments, replacing them with equivalent inline resources.

**Modules replaced per environment:**

| Environment | GCS | Secret Manager | gke-config | Total |
|-------------|-----|----------------|------------|-------|
| dev | 2 (data + logs) | 5 (rails, gcs, workos, github, replicated) | n/a | 7 |
| qa | 2 (data + logs) | 4 (rails, gcs, workos, github) | 1 (namespaces, quotas, SAs, network policies) | 7 |
| prod | 2 (data + logs) | 4 (rails, gcs, workos, github) | 1 (namespaces, quotas, SAs, network policies) | 7 |

**State migration:** Each environment has a `moved.tf` file with `moved` blocks that map old `module.<name>.<resource>` addresses to the new inline resource addresses. This ensures `terraform apply` migrates state without destroying/recreating infrastructure.

**Files changed:**
- **dev:** [storage.tf](environments/dev/terraform/storage.tf), [secrets.tf](environments/dev/terraform/secrets.tf), [outputs.tf](environments/dev/terraform/outputs.tf), [service-accounts.tf](environments/dev/terraform/service-accounts.tf), + new [moved.tf](environments/dev/terraform/moved.tf)
- **qa:** [main.tf](environments/qa/terraform/main.tf), [outputs.tf](environments/qa/terraform/outputs.tf), + new [moved.tf](environments/qa/terraform/moved.tf)
- **prod:** [main.tf](environments/prod/terraform/main.tf), [secrets.tf](environments/prod/terraform/secrets.tf), [outputs.tf](environments/prod/terraform/outputs.tf), + new [moved.tf](environments/prod/terraform/moved.tf)

**Validation:** All three environments pass `terraform init -backend=false` and `terraform validate` with zero errors, and no longer need to download private modules.

This means the backstage-pattern workflows (no secrets passed for module auth) will now work for this repo too. Ready to commit when you want to proceed.

     1→# CLAUDE.md - CrewAI Platform Service
     2→
     3→**Repository:** kix-services-crewai
     4→**Purpose:** Multi-environment deployment infrastructure for CrewAI Enterprise on GKE
     5→
     6→---
     7→
     8→## Extends Master Standards
     9→
    10→> **IMPORTANT:** This file extends the **master CLAUDE.md** with service-specific guidance.
    11→>
    12→> **Universal standards (security, git workflow, operational rules) are defined in:**

    14→>
    15→> **This file contains:**
    16→> - Repository structure and architecture

    18→> - Helm values and ArgoCD configuration
    19→> - Environment-specific conventions
    20→> - Key patterns and decisions
    21→
    22→---
    23→
    24→## Repository Overview
    25→
    26→This is the **kix-services-crewai** repository - deployment infrastructure for **CrewAI Enterprise Platform** across dev, qa, and prod environments on Google Kubernetes Engine.
    27→
    28→**Mission:** Deploy and manage CrewAI Enterprise using Terraform for infrastructure and ArgoCD for application delivery, composing remote modules from kix-platform-modules.
    29→
    30→## Repository Structure
    31→
    32→```
    33→kix-services-crewai/
    34→├── environments/
    35→│   ├── dev/
    36→│   │   ├── argocd/
    37→│   │   │   └── application.yaml      # ArgoCD multi-source Application
    38→│   │   ├── helm/
    39→│   │   │   └── values.yaml           # Helm values for OCI chart
    40→│   │   └── terraform/
    41→│   │       ├── backend.tf            # GCS state backend
    42→│   │       ├── main.tf               # Infrastructure composition
    43→│   │       ├── outputs.tf
    44→│   │       ├── variables.tf
    45→│   │       ├── versions.tf
    46→│   │       └── README.md             # Auto-generated terraform-docs
    47→│   ├── qa/                           # Same structure as dev
    48→│   └── prod/                         # Same structure as dev
    49→├── docs/
    50→│   ├── INDEX.md                      # Documentation index
    51→│   ├── SETUP.md                      # Setup instructions
    52→│   ├── QUICK_REFERENCE.md            # Quick reference
    53→│   ├── CICD.md                       # CI/CD architecture
    54→│   ├── CREW_NAMESPACE.md             # Crew namespace docs
    55→│   ├── runbooks/                     # Operational runbooks
    56→│   ├── archive/                      # Historical documents
    57→│   ├── changelog/                    # Change records
    58→│   ├── prps/                         # Product requirements
    59→│   └── tasks/                        # Task breakdowns
    60→├── CLAUDE.md                         # This file
    61→└── README.md                         # Main README
    62→```
    63→
    64→## Architecture
    65→
    66→### Deployment Model
    67→
    68→- **Infrastructure**: Terraform per environment, composing remote modules from [kix-platform-modules](https://github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules)
    69→- **Application**: External OCI Helm chart (`oci://registry.crewai.com/crewai/stable`) deployed via ArgoCD multi-source Application
    70→- **Secrets**: Terraform creates both GCP Secret Manager secrets and K8s secrets; pods consume credentials via `envFrom` secretRef
    71→- **Identity**: GCP service account with Workload Identity binding to K8s service account
    72→
    73→### Environment Layout
    74→
    75→| Environment | GKE Project | Platform Data Project | Cloud SQL Instance |
    76→|------------|-------------|----------------------|-------------------|
    77→| dev | kd-ix-eur-dev-gke | kd-ix-eur-dev-platform-data | kd-ix-eur-dev-cloudsql-platform |
    78→| qa | kd-ix-eur-qa-gke | kd-ix-eur-qa-platform-data | kd-ix-eur-qa-cloudsql-platform |
    79→| prod | kd-ix-eur-prod-gke | kd-ix-eur-prod-platform-data | kd-ix-eur-prod-cloudsql-platform |
    80→
    81→### Namespace Pattern
    82→
    83→Each environment has two namespaces:
    84→- `crewai-{env}` - Platform services (web, worker, scheduler, etc.)
    85→- `crewai-crews-{env}` - Crew workload execution (isolated from platform)
    86→
    87→## Key Patterns and Decisions
    88→
    89→### Terraform Module Composition
    90→
    91→Terraform composes remote modules from kix-platform-modules (`?ref=main`) plus inline resources:
    92→
    93→**Remote modules used:**
    94→- `data-services/gcs` - GCS buckets (data + logs)
    95→- `secret-manager` - GCP Secret Manager secrets (one module call per secret)
    96→- `gke-config` - Kubernetes namespaces, resource quotas, network policies, K8s service accounts
    97→
    98→**Inline resources (not in modules):**
    99→- Cloud SQL databases and user on existing instance (data source lookup)
   100→- GCP service account (inline to avoid circular dependency with HMAC keys)
   101→- HMAC keys for S3-compatible GCS access
   102→- IAM bindings (Cloud SQL client, GCS access, Workload Identity)
   103→- Artifact Registry repository for crew container image builds
   104→- Kubernetes secrets for application credential consumption
   105→- Random passwords for DB, SECRET_KEY_BASE, PLATFORM_MASTER_KEY
   106→
   107→### Secret-Manager Module Interface
   108→
   109→The secret-manager module uses a **single-secret-per-call pattern**:
   110→
   111→```hcl
   112→module "secret_db_credentials" {
   113→  source = "github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules//terraform/gcp/secret-manager?ref=main"
   114→
   115→  project_id  = var.gke_project_id
   116→  environment = var.environment
   117→  secret_id   = "crewai-db-credentials-${var.environment}"
   118→  secret_data = jsonencode({
   119→    password = random_password.db_password.result
   120→    host     = data.google_sql_database_instance.platform.private_ip_address
   121→    port     = 5432
   122→    database = "crewai_plus_production"
   123→    username = "crewai"
   124→  })
   125→
   126→  accessor_service_accounts = [google_service_account.crewai_platform.email]
   127→  additional_labels         = local.labels
   128→}
   129→```
   130→
   131→Each secret type gets its own module call: `secret_db_credentials`, `secret_gcs_credentials`, `secret_oauth_credentials`, `secret_helm_registry`.
   132→
   133→### Helm Values and Secret Wiring
   134→
   135→Pods receive credentials via `envFrom` referencing the Terraform-managed K8s secret:
   136→
   137→```yaml
   138→envFrom:
   139→  - secretRef:
   140→      name: "crewai-credentials"
   141→```
   142→
   143→The K8s secret `crewai-credentials` contains: `DB_PASSWORD`, `SECRET_KEY_BASE`, `PLATFORM_MASTER_KEY`, `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID`, `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY`, `WORKOS_CLIENT_ID`, `WORKOS_API_KEY`.
   144→
   145→### Service Account Management
   146→
   147→**Terraform manages the K8s service account** via the `gke-config` module. Helm values set `serviceAccount.create: false` to avoid conflict:
   148→
   149→```yaml
   150→serviceAccount:
   151→  create: false
   152→  name: "crewai-platform-sa"
   153→```
   154→
   155→### ArgoCD Multi-Source Application
   156→
   157→ArgoCD uses multi-source to pull the OCI chart and git values separately:
   158→
   159→```yaml
   160→sources:
   161→  - repoURL: oci://registry.crewai.com/crewai/stable
   162→    targetRevision: "0.3.10"
   163→    chart: crewai-enterprise
   164→    helm:
   165→      valueFiles:
   166→        - $values/environments/{env}/helm/values.yaml
   167→  - repoURL: https://github.com/konecta-ix-services/kix-services-crewai.git
   168→    targetRevision: main
   169→    ref: values
   170→```
   171→
   172→### Pod Security Standards
   173→
   174→- Dev/QA: `baseline` mode with `enforce`
   175→- Prod: `baseline` mode with `enforce` (required for BuildKit capabilities)
   176→
   177→BuildKit needs capabilities like CHOWN and DAC_OVERRIDE, which are blocked by `restricted` PSS.
   178→
   179→## Terraform State
   180→
   181→State is stored in per-environment GCS buckets with prefix `services/crewai/resources`:
   182→
   183→| Environment | Backend Bucket | Prefix |
   184→|------------|---------------|--------|
   185→| dev | kd-tfstate-dev | services/crewai/resources |
   186→| qa | kd-tfstate-qa | services/crewai/resources |
   187→| prod | kd-tfstate-prod | services/crewai/resources |
   188→
   189→## Validation Commands
   190→
   191→```bash
   192→# Format check
   193→cd environments/{env}/terraform
   194→terraform fmt -check
   195→
   196→# Initialize (no backend for validation)
   197→terraform init -backend=false
   198→
   199→# Validate
   200→terraform validate
   201→
   202→# Lint
   203→tflint
   204→
   205→# Generate docs
   206→terraform-docs markdown table . > README.md
   207→```
   208→
   209→## Common Tasks
   210→
   211→### Adding a New Environment Variable
   212→
   213→1. Add the value source to `main.tf` (variable, random_password, or data source)
   214→2. Add the key to the `kubernetes_secret.crewai_credentials` data block
   215→3. Run `terraform apply` - pods will pick up the new secret via `envFrom`
   216→
   217→### Upgrading CrewAI Version
   218→
   219→1. Update `targetRevision` in `environments/{env}/argocd/application.yaml`
   220→2. Commit and push
   221→3. ArgoCD auto-syncs (dev/qa) or manually sync (prod)
   222→
   223→### Rotating Database Password
   224→
   225→1. Taint the random_password: `terraform taint random_password.db_password`
   226→2. Run `terraform apply` - updates Cloud SQL user, Secret Manager, and K8s secret
   227→
   228→## Mistakes Learned
   229→
   230→### Secret-Manager Module Interface Mismatch
   231→
   232→The `feature/crewai-platform` branch of kix-platform-modules has a different secret-manager interface (multi-credential pattern) than `main` branch (single-secret-per-call). Since terraform references `?ref=main`, always use the main branch interface with individual module calls per secret.
   233→
   234→### Dual Service Account Creation
   235→
   236→Both Helm (`serviceAccount.create: true`) and Terraform (`gke-config` module) can create the same K8s service account. Always set `serviceAccount.create: false` in Helm values since Terraform manages the SA with Workload Identity binding.
   237→
   238→### PSS vs BuildKit
   239→
   240→CrewAI Builder uses BuildKit which requires Linux capabilities blocked by `restricted` Pod Security Standards. Use `baseline` PSS level for all environments.
   241→
   242→## Repository Relationships
   243→
   244→- **[kix-platform-modules](https://github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules)** - Terraform modules consumed by this repo
   245→- **[kix-platform-infrastructure](https://github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-infrastructure)** - Platform-level infrastructure
   246→- **[kix-platform-docs](https://github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-docs)** - Master CLAUDE.md and platform documentation
   247→
   248→---
   249→
   250→**Document Version:** 1.0
   251→**Last Updated:** February 2026
   252→**Maintained By:** Platform Engineering Team
   253→
```

  "old_string": "### Terraform Module Composition\n\nTerraform composes remote modules from kix-platform-modules (`?ref=main`) plus inline resources:\n\n**Remote modules used:**\n- `data-services/gcs` - GCS buckets (data + logs)\n- `secret-manager` - GCP Secret Manager secrets (one module call per secret)\n- `gke-config` - Kubernetes namespaces, resource quotas, network policies, K8s service accounts\n\n**Inline resources (not in modules):**\n- Cloud SQL databases and user on existing instance (data source lookup)\n- GCP service account (inline to avoid circular dependency with HMAC keys)\n- HMAC keys for S3-compatible GCS access\n- IAM bindings (Cloud SQL client, GCS access, Workload Identity)\n- Artifact Registry repository for crew container image builds\n- Kubernetes secrets for application credential consumption\n- Random passwords for DB, SECRET_KEY_BASE, PLATFORM_MASTER_KEY\n\n### Secret-Manager Module Interface\n\nThe secret-manager module uses a **single-secret-per-call pattern**:\n\n```hcl\nmodule \"secret_db_credentials\" {\n  source = \"github.com/konecta-ix-platform/kix-platform-modules//terraform/gcp/secret-manager?ref=main\"\n\n  project_id  = var.gke_project_id\n  environment = var.environment\n  secret_id   = \"crewai-db-credentials-${var.environment}\"\n  secret_data = jsonencode({\n    password = random_password.db_password.result\n    host     = data.google_sql_database_instance.platform.private_ip_address\n    port     = 5432\n    database = \"crewai_plus_production\"\n    username = \"crewai\"\n  })\n\n  accessor_service_accounts = [google_service_account.crewai_platform.email]\n  additional_labels         = local.labels\n}\n```\n\nEach secret type gets its own module call: `secret_db_credentials`, `secret_gcs_credentials`, `secret_oauth_credentials`, `secret_helm_registry`.",
  "new_string": "### Terraform Resource Pattern\n\nAll Terraform resources are defined inline (no remote module dependencies). This eliminates the need for authenticated access to private repos during `terraform init` and simplifies CI/CD.\n\n**Infrastructure resources managed:**\n- GCS buckets (data + logs) with `google_storage_bucket`\n- GCP Secret Manager secrets with inline `google_secret_manager_secret`, `_version`, and `_iam_member` resources\n- Kubernetes namespaces, resource quotas, limit ranges, and service accounts (QA/prod also include network policies)\n- Cloud SQL databases and user on existing instance (data source lookup)\n- GCP service account with Workload Identity binding\n- HMAC keys for S3-compatible GCS access\n- IAM bindings (Cloud SQL client, GCS access, Workload Identity)\n- Artifact Registry repository for crew container image builds\n- Kubernetes secrets for application credential consumption\n- Random passwords for DB, SECRET_KEY_BASE, PLATFORM_MASTER_KEY\n\n### Secret Manager Pattern\n\nEach secret is managed by three inline resources:\n\n```hcl\nresource \"google_secret_manager_secret\" \"db_credentials\" {\n  project   = var.gke_project_id\n  secret_id = \"crewai-db-credentials-${var.environment}\"\n  labels    = local.labels\n  replication {\n    user_managed {\n      replicas { location = \"europe-west1\" }\n      replicas { location = \"europe-west4\" }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nresource \"google_secret_manager_secret_version\" \"db_credentials\" {\n  secret=[REDACTED].db_credentials.id\n  secret_data = jsonencode({ ... })\n}\n\nresource \"google_secret_manager_secret_iam_member\" \"db_credentials\" {\n  secret_id = google_secret_manager_secret.db_credentials.id\n  role      = \"roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor\"\n  member    = \"serviceAccount:${google_service_account.crewai_platform.email}\"\n}\n```"
}

     1→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
     2→# Service Accounts and IAM Bindings
     3→#
     4→# GCP service account for CrewAI platform workloads with Workload Identity.
     5→# Includes all IAM bindings for Cloud SQL, GCS, and Artifact Registry access.
     6→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
     7→
     8→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
     9→# GCP Service Account
    10→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    11→# Created inline (not via module) to avoid circular dependencies with HMAC keys
    12→# and secrets that reference the service account email.
    13→
    14→resource "google_service_account" "crewai_platform" {
    15→  project      = var.gke_project_id
    16→  account_id   = "crewai-platform"
    17→  display_name = "CrewAI Platform"
    18→}
    19→
    20→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    21→# IAM: Cloud SQL Access
    22→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    23→# Allows the service account to connect to Cloud SQL via the Cloud SQL Proxy.
    24→
    25→resource "google_project_iam_member" "cloudsql_client" {
    26→  project = var.platform_data_project
    27→  role    = "roles/cloudsql.client"
    28→  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.crewai_platform.email}"
    29→}
    30→
    31→resource "google_project_iam_member" "cloudsql_instance_user" {
    32→  project = var.platform_data_project
    33→  role    = "roles/cloudsql.instanceUser"
    34→  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.crewai_platform.email}"
    35→}
    36→
    37→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    38→# IAM: GCS Bucket Access
    39→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    40→# Data bucket: full object admin for reading and writing application data.
    41→# Logs bucket: object creator only for write-only audit logging.
    42→
    43→resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "data_bucket" {
    44→  bucket = google_storage_bucket.gcs_data.name
    45→  role   = "roles/storage.objectAdmin"
    46→  member = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.crewai_platform.email}"
    47→}
    48→
    49→resource "google_storage_bucket_iam_member" "logs_bucket" {
    50→  bucket = google_storage_bucket.gcs_logs.name
    51→  role   = "roles/storage.objectCreator"
    52→  member = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.crewai_platform.email}"
    53→}
    54→
    55→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    56→# IAM: Shared Artifact Registry Access
    57→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    58→# Allows the service account to pull container images from the shared
    59→# Artifact Registry repository (crewai-images in kd-ix-eur-shr-artifacts).
    60→# These are the mirrored CrewAI platform images synced from images.crewai.com.
    61→
    62→resource "google_artifact_registry_repository_iam_member" "shared_ar_reader" {
    63→  project    = var.shared_artifacts_project
    64→  location   = var.region
    65→  repository = var.shared_ar_repository
    66→  role       = "roles/artifactregistry.reader"
    67→  member     = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.crewai_platform.email}"
    68→}
    69→
    70→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    71→# IAM: Secret Manager Access (for External Secrets Operator)
    72→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    73→# Allows the service account to access secrets in Secret Manager.
    74→# Required for ESO to pull secrets and create Kubernetes secrets.
    75→
    76→resource "google_project_iam_member" "secret_accessor" {
    77→  project = var.security_project_id
    78→  role    = "roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor"
    79→  member  = "serviceAccount:${google_service_account.crewai_platform.email}"
    80→}
    81→
    82→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    83→# IAM: Workload Identity Binding
    84→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    85→# Allows the Kubernetes service account to impersonate the GCP service account.
    86→# This enables pods to authenticate to GCP services without service account keys.
    87→
    88→resource "google_service_account_iam_member" "workload_identity" {
    89→  service_account_id = google_service_account.crewai_platform.name
    90→  role               = "roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser"
    91→  member             = "serviceAccount:${var.gke_project_id}.svc.id.goog[crewai/crewai-sa]"
    92→}
    93→
    94→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    95→# IAM: GitHub Actions Impersonation
    96→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    97→# Allows GitHub Actions to impersonate this service account for CI/CD.
    98→# The GitHub service account is created separately in the platform infrastructure.
    99→
   100→resource "google_service_account_iam_member" "github_impersonation" {
   101→  service_account_id = google_service_account.crewai_platform.name
   102→  role               = "roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator"
   103→  member             = "serviceAccount:github-crewai-${var.environment}@${var.gke_project_id}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
   104→}
   105→

> AGENT

Validates cleanly. With `default = false`, the plan will destroy the existing IAM binding from state since the CI SA doesn't have permission to read it anyway. That's the desired outcome — on Standard clusters this binding isn't needed.

The change:
- Added `enable_shared_ar_iam` variable (default `false`) to [variables.tf:139-144](environments/dev/terraform/variables.tf#L139-L144)
- Added `count` conditional to the `shared_ar_reader` resource in [service-accounts.tf:63](environments/dev/terraform/service-accounts.tf#L63)

Terraform will plan to destroy the IAM binding it can't read anyway, which resolves the 403 error. If you ever move back to Autopilot, set `enable_shared_ar_iam = true`.

Ready to commit and push when you say.

That's the core issue. The workflows were copied from backstage, but backstage has no sensitive Terraform variables — everything has defaults. The crewai repo has `oauth_client_id`, `oauth_api_key`, `github_client_secret`, etc. that need to come from GitHub Secrets as `TF_VAR_*` environment variables.

The problem: reusable workflow calls (`uses:`) can't have `env:` blocks, so there's no way to inject `TF_VAR_*` environment variables into the plan/apply jobs.
